reply.emotion: satisfied and grounded, checking the bank account on payday
notes: Use el sueldo for the regular monthly or biweekly pay you receive from an employer. It is very common in office and professional contexts.
Compare with el salario, which is nearly identical and also means salary or wages, though sueldo often implies a fixed regular payment for salaried employees.

senses.definition: Cantidad de dinero que se recibe regularmente por realizar un trabajo.

examples.text: Con mi nuevo sueldo puedo ahorrar más dinero cada mes.
examples.translation: With my new salary I can save more money every month.
examples.emotion: pleased and optimistic about future savings
